# Reporting Issues

To report an issue or request a feature, visit [{{< var ISSUE_PAGE >}}]({{< var ISSUE_PAGE >}}).

When entering an issue, please include the following:

- A description of the issue or feature request
- If an issue, step-by-step instructions for how to reproduce it
- If a feature request, explain how you would like for the feature to work and a possible use case
- The version of *{{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}}* and your operating system information\
  (this can be copied from the program's **About** dialog)
- Any supporting documents or screenshots\
  (please do not include sensitive or confidential data)

::: {.warningsection data-latex=""}
Any issue that you report will be publicly available and can be read by anyone.
Do not include any personal or proprietary information or files in your report.
:::
